sentences.en: Can you hear me okay? Your voice keeps cutting in and out.
Could you share your screen so we can go over the slides together?
sentences.ko: 슬라이드를 같이 볼 수 있도록 화면을 공유해 주시겠어요?

sentences.en: I'm totally swamped today—let's catch up over chat instead of a call.
sentences.ko: 오늘 너무 정신없어서요. 통화 대신 채팅으로 연락할게요.

sentences.en: I'll send you a quick summary of what we covered in the meeting.
sentences.ko: 회의에서 다룬 내용을 간단히 정리해서 보내드릴게요.

sentences.en: Working from home has really grown on me—I can't imagine going back.
sentences.ko: 재택근무가 점점 저한테 잘 맞는 것 같아요. 다시 출근하는 건 상상도 못하겠어요.
